name: Splunk - Data & Source Enumeration
description: SPL queries for discovering available indexes, sourcetypes, sources, fields, and data distribution in a Splunk environment. Essential first step when approaching an unknown Splunk instance or starting a new threat hunt.
source: CDSA Module 05: Understanding Log Sources & Investigating with Splunk
notes:
=== Enumerate Available Indexes ===
  | eventcount summarize=false index=* | table index

=== Enumerate All Sourcetypes (All Indexes) ===
  | metadata type=sourcetypes
  | metadata type=sourcetypes index=* | table sourcetype

=== Enumerate All Sources ===
  | metadata type=sources index=* | table source

=== Inspect Raw Events for a Sourcetype ===
  sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" | table _raw
  sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" | table *       (all extracted fields)

=== View Specific Fields ===
  sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" | fields Account_Name, EventCode | table Account_Name, EventCode

=== Field Summary for a Sourcetype ===
  sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" | fieldsummary
  (shows all fields, coverage %, distinct count)

=== Data Volume by Index/Sourcetype Over Time ===
  index=* sourcetype=* | bucket _time span=1d | stats count by _time, index, sourcetype | sort - _time

=== Rare Index/Sourcetype Combinations ===
  index=* sourcetype=* | rare limit=10 index, sourcetype

=== Rare Parent Processes (anomaly indicator) ===
  index="main" | rare limit=20 useother=f ParentImage

=== Low-Frequency Fields (unusual data) ===
  index=* sourcetype=* | fieldsummary | where count < 100 | table field, count, distinct_count

=== Data Distribution Across Hosts/Sources ===
  index=* | sistats count by index, sourcetype, source, host

=== Rare Combinations of Multiple Fields ===
  index=* sourcetype=* | rare limit=10 field1, field2, field3

=== Retrieve All Events (no time limit) ===
  index="main" earliest=0

=== Common Windows Sourcetypes ===
  WinEventLog:Security     → auth, account, logon/logoff events
  WinEventLog:Sysmon       → Sysmon process/network/file/registry events
  WinEventLog:System       → service installs, driver loads
  WinEventLog:Application  → application-level events
  WinEventLog:sysmon       → (lowercase variant — check both)
  linux:syslog             → Linux system and network logs
  XmlWinEventLog:Sysmon    → alternate XML format for Sysmon
